status: Feature/outcome nomination fixed for planning; no launchable predictive cohort or power specification
selection_exposure: Source signals were inspected in prior A1 work; this is explicitly source-informed, not a pre-data discovery claim

primary_feature.measurement: log2(mean CPM mark / mean CPM H3), exact interval integration; both cover >=80% and have positive means; no pseudocount
primary_feature.interpretation: Local relative enrichment, not absolute/global histone modification or causal regulation

biological_rationale: Test whether regulatory retention/loss of an AT2 identity locus adds information beyond early RNA about a later mature descendant outcome; it may simply track existing RNA, which is the explicit rival
baseline_features: pre-exposure viable input and declared design variables

outcome.primary: Viable lineage-labelled descendants meeting independently fixed AT1 protein and morphology criteria per 1000 labelled input cells, after a fixed AT1 differentiation regime
outcome.required_criteria: AGER and late-AT1 CAV1 protein plus flattened AT1-compatible morphology; thresholds fixed with external positive/negative controls before outcome comparison. PDPN/HOPX alone is insufficient.
outcome.time: One regime-specific later time must be fixed from independent protocol evidence before candidate data are scored; none is inferred from an RNA snapshot
outcome.function: Separate functional assay required for a repair-function claim

linkage: Sibling aliquots or lineage-linked preparations with parent line, donor, isolation and time recorded; destructive chromatin and fate are not measured in the same cell
prediction_test: Training-only fixed RNA/design baseline versus baseline plus this one feature; held-out parent line/donor for transport, with within-line preparation validation labelled separately; compare absolute error and calibration
stop: Do not fit until all open fields are resolved. A different assembly or endpoint requires an explicit amendment, not silent transfer.
design_amendment: Before any new scores or model: late-marker requirement clarified from Choi Figure 7 while constructing P5; no existing results changed.
